guard:
Missing Vercel ids: VERCEL_ORG_ID VERCEL_PROJECT_ID

The prebuilt deploy flow (vercel pull -> vercel build --prod ->
vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod) cannot run without BOTH ids, so
this job fails fast instead of silently falling back to a remote
build.

Fix: add them as REPOSITORY secrets (not environment secrets) at
  https://github.com/dsetzer84/apexaudit/settings/secrets/actions

  VERCEL_ORG_ID     = team_7P3XiCtGMPpsXTcvwYArR9qp
  VERCEL_PROJECT_ID = prj_fdcWMKHKknGHvoH78LeKXsQonCiI

Common mistake: adding them to the wrong repo
(dsetzer84/ApexAudit-AI instead of dsetzer84/apexaudit).
